summary: Cursive MVP — comprehensive backend + frontend validation. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests PASS (100%) covering root, content (27 pieces, 8 categories, filtering, 404), archive (5 docs, 404), sessions (create + persisted + sorted desc), progress (totals, streaks, by-category, unknown-user zeros), profiles (upsert + 404), favorites (idempotent add + list + delete + verify gone), penpal (signup + idempotent + 422 on invalid email). Frontend (web preview, mobile viewport 390x844): onboarding, skip→studio, studio (26 letter tiles, 8 word pills, lowercase/uppercase toggle), collections (27 cards + 9 category chips incl. 'all'), category filter, archive list (5 docs), progress (streak-card + totals), profile (guest mode, name save persists as 'Tester'), penpal (full signup→thank-you) all PASS. Skia-dependent screens (practice/[letter], session write phase, archive transcribe phase) crash on web with 'CanvasKit undefined → Cannot read properties of undefined (reading PictureRecorder/Path)'. This is a known canvaskit-wasm web-init issue — must be validated on Expo Go (iOS/Android) per agent context note.

integration_issues.flow: Practice screen (Skia) / Session write phase / Archive transcribe phase
integration_issues.issue: On web preview, @shopify/react-native-skia HandwritingCanvas throws 'CanvasKit is not defined' and 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Path/PictureRecorder)' at src/components/HandwritingCanvas.tsx:47 when guideStrokes/Skia.Path.Make() is called before canvaskit-wasm has loaded. This crashes the React tree and breaks subsequent navigation until reload. Studio/Collections list/Archive list/Progress/Profile/Penpal all render correctly because they don't import Skia. RECOMMENDATION: (1) add a Skia readiness gate (e.g., useCanvasRef + WithSkiaWeb / loadSkiaWeb wrapper) before mounting <Canvas>; (2) wrap HandwritingCanvas in an Error Boundary so crashes don't kill navigation; (3) defer guideStrokes computation until after CanvasKit ready. Also: package version mismatch warning — @shopify/react-native-skia@2.6.2 expected 2.2.12 for Expo SDK; consider aligning to expected versions to avoid wasm-loader regressions.

react_native_issues.issue: Line 47 calls Skia.Path.Make() inside top-level useMemo before CanvasKit is available on web. Needs WithSkiaWeb wrapper or readiness check.

Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents); useNativeDriver fallback to JS animation. Cosmetic on web — does not affect functionality.

rca_of_issue: Skia canvas screens fail on web because @shopify/react-native-skia requires canvaskit.wasm to be loaded before any Skia.Path.Make() call. In HandwritingCanvas.tsx:47 the guideStrokes useMemo executes synchronously on first render and calls Skia.Path.Make() which dereferences global CanvasKit — throwing 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Path)' on web. Fix on web: import { WithSkiaWeb } from '@shopify/react-native-skia/lib/module/web' and gate the canvas mount, or call loadSkiaWeb() in app/_layout.tsx before rendering Skia screens. On native (Expo Go), CanvasKit isn't used (Skia is JNI/native), so this error will not occur. Reproduction: Skip onboarding → Studio → tap any letter tile → red screen on web.
